reviews.text: My little ones love it!!

I am so happy and grateful to have found Flávia to take care of my puppy. He is very temperamental, and from the first day she showed him extreme affection and patience, and it's impressive how much his behavior has improved since she started caring for him, and it's clear how much he loves being with her.
I 100% recommend her work, an excellent professional and an unparalleled human being!!
Excellent. She took very good care of my little snowflake and was very affectionate with him.

Flávia treats my family member with great respect, and Max is very happy when Flávia comes to pick him up for his daily walk. Thank you, dear Flávia, Max and I appreciate your affection and love. 🥰🥰❤️❤️ …
I've had countless dog walkers in São Paulo and I can say that Flávia is the best. Always available and eager to help, she also has a special way of handling dogs. I highly recommend her.
You do your job with all the love and dignity in the world ❤️
Nowhere to leave your pet? I highly recommend her. She is responsible and takes care of pets with love, affection, and respect.

Flavia is very affectionate and caring. I have a Yorkshire Terrier with quite a temperament!! Because of work, I travel a lot, and I often need to leave him with her, and I do it with my eyes closed because I know she takes care of him with so much love.
I highly recommend her work! S2
An angel in my life and, of course, in my dogs' lives. She always helps with my babies, being kind, willing, and helpful. Sometimes I think she loves my dogs more than I do. Hehe
Lupita loves Aunt Flavia <3<3
Fla is extremely loving and caring with our pets! I highly recommend her!!!!

I am extremely satisfied with Flávia's work. She is dedicated, patient, and very professional. From day one, she showed immense affection for my pet, always using positive and respectful methods. In just a few sessions, I've already noticed a great improvement in his behavior; he's more obedient, calm, and confident. Furthermore, she always gives me practical tips to maintain the progress at home. I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone who wants not only to train but also to create an even stronger bond with their animal. 🐾💖
We can feel the affection and genuine love they have for the animals 👏🏻👏🏻 …
Flavia is very upbeat and affectionate with my babies!
Excellent professional! Highly recommend!!
Flávia is incredibly careful and loving! It's clear how much she loves what she does! We are so grateful to someone who takes such good care of our Abel! A dog that has activities is a happy dog!!
Very careful and attentive with my dogs. You can tell they are well cared for by the fuss they make when she comes home to pick them up. I highly recommend her.

Flavia is wonderful! Always very affectionate with my dogs, she treats them as if they were her own. She has super flexible availability and is very professional. She's always there to save us when we need support the most (work, emergencies, vacations, and any unforeseen events). I feel at ease knowing they are in good hands. I am super grateful to you! 🐶💛🐶
Excellent professional
Flávia is wonderful! My family is a big fan. We feel completely safe leaving our beloved pet with her and knowing she has free access to our home. Besides being ethical, she is extremely kind.
Her work is wonderful, I highly recommend her. She takes great care of the dogs ❤️❤️
She is excellent!

Excellent professional, I left my puppy with her, she took great care of him, he played so much that he came home and slept through the whole night lol.
I highly recommend her.
I left my kittens with her. They were very well treated. I would definitely leave them with her again.
I highly recommend her, she's very loving and attentive to my dogs. Lots of love involved.
It was a wonderful experience, my Antônio loved the stay, my sincere thanks to the dog walker Flávia, who is also very kind.
She was wonderful with my kittens. I highly recommend her.
Professional preparation, dedication, and very responsible. Love for the work she does. I recommend her.
Excellent professional, super caring and dedicated... my kittens love Auntie Fla, they arrive and immediately run to her lap... 🥰🫶🏻😍👏🏻👏🏻 …
I highly recommend it.
Top place and the girls have a real love for the animals. It's hard to see something like that. They do it out of love and not just for money!!!
